name: Macronutrient Calculator
description: Calculate daily protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets in grams and calories based on your daily energy intake and fitness goals.
search_intent: Calculate daily macronutrient intake (grams of protein, carbs, and fat) from calorie goals.

inputs.label: Body weight (kg, optional for protein check)

outputs.label: Protein intake per kg body weight (g/kg)

calculation: Atwater standard energy factors: Protein = 4 kcal/gram, Carbohydrates = 4 kcal/gram, Dietary Fat = 9 kcal/gram. Split percentages: Balanced = 30% Protein, 40% Carbs, 30% Fat; Fat Loss = 35% Protein, 35% Carbs, 30% Fat; Muscle Gain = 30% Protein, 50% Carbs, 20% Fat; Low Carb / Keto = 25% Protein, 5% Carbs, 70% Fat; Endurance = 20% Protein, 60% Carbs, 20% Fat. Calories allocated = dailyCalories × (percentage / 100). Grams = round(calories / energyFactor). Protein per kg = round(proteinGrams / bodyWeightKg, 2).
limitations: Macro distributions represent general educational and sports nutrition guidelines, not medical diet prescriptions.
Individuals with metabolic conditions, diabetes, or renal disease should consult a registered dietitian or physician.
Actual food energy density can vary by dietary fiber content and food preparation.
